pooling: mean Q / mean V over six equally weighted phases and both seeds; never mean ratios
seed_floor: sample SD of the two separately pooled seed absolute-ratio deviations and fair-energy scores: absolute difference divided by sqrt(2); fixed from reference, not a population uncertainty estimate
joint_score: identity-scale fair energy of the six-dimensional vector, equal pair/phase/seed weight; strict reduction beyond frozen seed score floor
selector: minimize candidate sampled-coarse fair energy pooled on ph012/013; ties earliest checkpoint; compare its preceding checkpoint, or following checkpoint when first selected
advancement: same configuration at selected and adjacent checkpoint, both coarse modes: point ratio gain >=10% AND absolute gain >= frozen ratio floor; score decrease > frozen score floor; simultaneous phase-bootstrap lower bounds positive for these two margins; no >2 percentage-point 90%-interval-content regression or >2% coordinatewise fair-CRPS regression
phase_bootstrap: all 6^6 ordered phase resamples, keeping both seeds, all pairs and shared draws; percentile lower-tail probability 0.05/16 for two configurations x two checkpoints x two modes x two primary margins; this nominal bootstrap must still pass independent full-rule null calibration
screen: exists any of two configurations at any of four checkpoints with pooled sampled-coarse ratio improvement >=10% and >= frozen seed ratio floor; ignores actual selector, adjacent stability, true coarse, proper score, bootstrap significance and guardrails; necessary condition only
screen_decision: reject only when a simultaneous Hoeffding upper bound is below 0.8 at either 20% or 40% effect; otherwise unresolved, never pass
synthetic_law: whole-phase covariance averages the two seed covariances then shrinks 10% to its diagonal; predictive trace and expected error trace match each phase/seed baseline. Shared standardized phase truth errors are perfectly aligned across seeds (favorable pairing). Candidate Gaussian/common/heavy arms rescale variance globally to the exact target pooled ratio; biased arms shrink common-direction bias globally to that target. Heavy-tail radial factors are t5 and common-mode retains 25% trace rank-one perturbation. Same truths across all candidates/checkpoints and shared radial factors across paired draws. These are declared conditional surrogates, not calibrated physical posteriors.
required_if_screen_unresolved: implement and independently calibrate complete executable selection/bootstrap/score/coverage rule including calibrated and decorrelated negative controls before any Gate 2 pass
